task: Minimalist Banner Keeper and Runner faces

edits.name: Banner Keeper

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached existing Banner Keeper paired game figure sheet. The user wants less defined, less human, more minimalist faces.
Change ONLY the facial rendering of BOTH figures, ivory on the left and charcoal on the right. Replace the human doll portrait faces with understated abstract painted miniature/token faces: broad smooth skin-colored painted areas, tiny short dark dash marks for eyes, a barely suggested nose through the existing outer contour, and no drawn mouth. Remove the present smile, lips, realistic cheek detail, blush, eye whites, iris, pupils, lashes, and expressive eyebrows. Reduce anatomical modeling of the face to simple broad tonal planes. Keep the actual skin hue and the exact head size, direction, ears, face outline, and braided hair silhouette. The new face should read clearly as a minimalist game miniature, not a human portrait and not a large-eyed cartoon. Do not add a mask, helmet, visor, or new accessory.
Everything outside the exposed face must remain visually unchanged: exact pose, body, hand shapes and fingers, ivory/charcoal army colors, hair, clothing and its folds and trim, boots, banners, banner symbols and poles, materials and existing illustration style. Preserve both complete figures, full banners and finials, all silhouettes and spacing. Same original paired composition and framing, 1536 × 1024 landscape PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. No background scenery, no lettering, no cropped edges, no watermark.
attempts.check: Human smile and features removed, but vertical dark eyes were too tall and cartoon-like.

attempts.prompt:

Remove the smile and mouth completely, remove lips, eye whites, pupils, irises, lashes, expressive eyebrows, blush, realistic cheeks and anatomical facial shading. Preserve the exact original skin hue, face silhouette, head size and direction, ears, neck and braided hair silhouette. attempts.check: Both faces are smooth simple skin-toned planes, tiny horizontal brown dash eyes, no mouth, iris, lashes, detailed cheeks or expression. Hair, flags, clothing, hands, full figures and framing retained.

edits.name: Runner

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached existing Runner paired game figure sheet. The user wants less defined, less human, more minimalist faces.
Change ONLY the facial rendering of BOTH figures, ivory on the left and charcoal on the right. Replace the human hero portrait features with an understated abstract painted miniature/token face: broad smooth skin-colored painted areas, one tiny short horizontal dark dash for each visible eye, a barely suggested nose through the existing outer contour, and no drawn mouth or lips. Remove the defined heroic brow, human eyeball and white, iris/pupil, realistic cheekbones and nasolabial detail, nostril lines and lip shading. Reduce anatomical modeling of the face to a few simple broad tonal planes. The single visible eye should be much smaller and simpler than the source. Keep the exact face outline with its subtle pointed nose in profile, head size/direction, skin hue, pointed ear and swept-back hair silhouette. It must clearly read as a minimalist game miniature, not a human portrait or large-eyed cartoon. Do not add a mask, helmet, visor or accessory.
Everything outside the facial area must stay visually unchanged: body, pose, hand shapes and fingers, hair and ears, ivory/charcoal army colors, clothing folds and trim, straps, boots, the spear held horizontally and three spears on the back, materials and original illustration style. Preserve both complete figures, full weapons, all silhouettes and exact spacing. Same original paired composition and framing, 1536 × 1024 landscape PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. No background scenery, lettering, cropped edges or watermark.
attempts.check: Both faces have a single small horizontal dash eye, broad smooth skin area, no lip, nostril, iris, eyebrow or realistic cheekbone rendering. Small profile nose is retained. Hair, pointed ears, body pose and all weapons remain.

edits.unintended_changes: Minor rendering drift: bolder contour lines and small hand/cloth shading changes. Face silhouette is cleaner and slightly flatter, consistent with requested abstraction. No material composition or equipment change.

verification: Each original was inspected with view_image before editing. All generated outputs were visually inspected inline. Final dimensions and real alpha verified read-only with Pillow; no raster edits were performed. Original inputs were already RGBA with alpha range 0–254; outputs preserve that alpha characteristic. No repository file written; root copies selected generated files.
